text: FAA guidance says start emergency procedures for loss of control link when connection cannot be reestablished, and the remote PIC must regain VLOS as soon as practicable. Autel EVO Max 4N manuals indicate that if reconnection is not established within 10 seconds, the app shows “Aircraft disconnected” and the drone executes the preset Signal Loss Action, with Auto RTH triggering if that option is set. Incident reports (unverified) describe loss of control shortly after takeoff, the platform flying away despite input, RTB failures, and the UAS not being located or recovered. Main gaps: conflicting implications that RTH/landing contingencies may succeed versus reported RTB failure; missing explicit post-loss actions, loss-of-control thresholds, and whether RTH can recover if relink occurs during RTH.
